# Garmin Connect library notes

This project uses the third-party `garminconnect` Python library to read data
from Garmin Connect. This is not an official Garmin API, so Garmin login and
token behavior can change outside our control.

## 2026-07-20

GitHub Actions started failing during Garmin login with:

```text
too many 429 error responses
```

Local runs still worked, so the problem was likely Garmin rate-limiting or
blocking fresh logins from GitHub-hosted runners.

Before this change, the GitHub job logged in to Garmin with email/password on
every run. Now it restores a saved Garmin token file from GitHub Secrets and
uses that tokenstore for authentication.

The code still passes Garmin email/password into `Garmin(...)`. This is okay:
when `GARMINTOKENS` is set, `garminconnect` tries the tokenstore first. The
email/password values are mainly fallback if tokens are missing or invalid.

We solved this by:

- updating `garminconnect` from `0.2.25` to `0.3.6`
- creating Garmin tokens locally in `.garminconnect/garmin_tokens.json`
- storing those token contents in the GitHub secret `GARMIN_TOKENS_JSON`
- restoring the token file in GitHub Actions before the job runs
- making the daily statistics job use the saved tokenstore when available

The job should now reuse Garmin tokens instead of doing a fresh Garmin
username/password login every day.

If Garmin authentication breaks again, regenerate tokens locally with:

```powershell
C:\Users\Urh\anaconda3\envs\trainingpeaks_customlog\python.exe -u .\daily_jobs\create_garmin_tokens.py
```

Then update the `GARMIN_TOKENS_JSON` GitHub secret with the new contents of
`.garminconnect/garmin_tokens.json`.
